name: Perth
tagline: Sunny beaches, quokkas and Swan River sunsets
summary: Perth is one of the sunniest cities on earth, with long white beaches, the vast Kings Park and the riverside port of Fremantle. Ride to Rottnest Island for a quokka selfie, swim at Cottesloe, and drive to the Pinnacles or the Margaret River wine region.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are perfect; summer is hot but great for beaches.
arrival: Perth Airport is 25 minutes from the city by the Airport Line train.
gettingAround: Transperth trains and buses; free CAT buses in the city.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; cash is rarely needed.
foodTip: Western rock lobster, Margaret River wine and Freo fish and chips.
buyTip: Broome pearls and Margaret River wine.
